# clavis access break-glass

<p class="cli-lead">Immediately grant break-glass access and lift an active freeze</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis access break-glass [flags]
```

</div>

For incidents: immediately grant yourself Admin access for a short
window, lift any active freeze, and write a loud audit event. Needs the
`settings:manage` permission.

## Examples

```sh
clavis access break-glass --env prod --reason "SEV-1 checkout outage" --duration 1h
```
